北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，气温适宜。出门记得防晒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and pleasant. Don't forget sunscreen!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波大雨，风力 6级。体感偏凉，外出请注意防雨防风。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has heavy rain and strong winds. It feels cool, dress for rain and wind.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海中雨，湿度大。出行带雨具，小心路滑。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has moderate rain and high humidity. Take an umbrella and watch your step.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，天气炎热。记得多喝水，注意防暑降温！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and hot. Stay hydrated and cool down!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，气温偏高。注意防暑，及时补水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and warm. Stay cool and rehydrate.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雨，风力 8级。体感偏凉，请注意添衣，出行务必安全！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has heavy rain and strong winds. It feels cool, dress warmly and stay safe!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 8级

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京小雨，湿度高。出门备好雨具，小心湿滑路面。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has light rain and high humidity. Bring an umbrella and watch for slippery roads.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗炎热，体感 37℃。请注意防晒防暑，多补水！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and very hot, feels like 37℃. Protect from sun and heat, hydrate!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，风力 6级。气温舒适，但风大注意安全哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy with strong winds. The temperature is pleasant, but be mindful of the wind.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 33℃。出门注意防晒，保持清爽。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels warm. Remember sun protection and stay refreshed.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 34℃。请多补充水分，避免中暑哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and feels like 34℃. Hydrate well to avoid heatstroke.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，气温宜人。适合户外活动，心情棒棒哒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and pleasant. Great for outdoor activities, enjoy your day!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，气温舒适。出门轻松，记得带伞以防万一。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and comfortable. Enjoy your day, maybe bring an umbrella just in case.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 17℃。早晚温差大，请注意添衣保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and feels like 17℃. Mind the temperature difference and dress warmly.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，风力 5级。外出注意防晒，小心大风哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast with moderate winds. Protect from sun and be aware of the wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 32℃。湿度较高，多补水，保持舒适。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast and feels like 32℃. High humidity, stay hydrated and comfortable.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，气温适中。湿度大，注意衣物选择，保持干爽。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and mild. High humidity, choose clothes carefully to stay dry.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，气温偏高。多喝水，注意防暑，保持活力！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is overcast and warm. Drink more water, stay cool and energetic!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雨伴大风，出门请务必注意安全，带好雨具！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has heavy rain and strong winds. Stay safe and bring your umbrella!
